Preserve those literals exactly only after an optional Technical details or Dettagli tecnici divider. Summarize relevant contents directly instead of sending the user to inspect files. State what approval covers and what it does not cover. A yes or ok applies only to the displayed decision unless the user explicitly grants a broader approval level; later delegated approvals must be recorded as automation, not misattributed as direct user actions.
